paragraphs.text: Captain Orthion , the Hero of Lavabrink , is a human soldier from Ikoria .

Orthion is a legendary soldier and hero of Lavabrink . He has brown skin and striking white hair worn in long dreadlocks, complemented by a full beard, he presents a commanding presence on the battlefield. His leather outfit, studded with blue-glowing crystals, signifies both his rank and his readiness for combat, while his cape adds a touch of grandeur befitting a legendary soldier. Orthion's primary weapon is a long spear.

He participated in the defense of Ikoria against the New Phyrexian Invasion , where he fought at the Lavabrink Floodgates . Here, he collaborated with the resident Lava Serpent and another lava monster to hold back the relentless Phyrexian hordes.
